text: Frontend data layer: load the whole project once and keep it live via pushed entities
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). The full graph (753 aims / 34 phases, 1.1MB) loads via aim.list in ~100-150ms, yet the frontend loads lazily per parent/phase: 55 call sites of loadPhases/loadPhaseAims/loadAims/loadFloatingAims, promise caches (phaseChildrenLoadPromises, loadedPhaseChildrenByParentId), ensureColumnNeighborhoodLoaded, 'missing aims' top-ups in the subscription handler. Correctness bug: loadProject only loads floating aims + phases, and the full aim set only arrives when GraphView mounts, so recalculateValues computes list-view value/cost/priority over a partial graph. Target: loadProject = meta + phase.list + aim.list (IndexedDB cache first), subscription always carries the entity, delete all lazy-load paths and their guards. Step 1: load all aims in loadProject.

status.comment: Committed; vitest 234/234, backend 70/70, e2e 19/19, type checks clean. Awaiting Felix's check that the list view feels right (values correct without opening the graph, edits from agents appear live).
